title: Dynamical zero modes, boundary dependence, and numerical instability in dynamical quantum phase transitions
summary: Boundary conditions are usually expected to cause only finite-size corrections to bulk quantities, but this expectation can fail for dynamical quantum phase transitions. In this work, we show that such boundary dependence is encoded in dynamical zero modes (DZMs) of the Loschmidt matrix, which are defined as singular vectors whose singular values vanish in the thermodynamic limit.
